claims: Every morning at 8am (later shown as 4:00 AM CDT) Claude automatically labels and categorizes all emails and drafts the responses
Setup takes 'literally 30 seconds': connect Gmail + Calendar, paste the prompt into Routines, hit Draft routine, pick schedule, Create
Routine output shown: calendar for today, 'Needs your attention' items, 'Partnership pipeline - awaiting brand reply' list of brand deals with quoted amounts
Routine run shows 'Used 2 tools' steps: check Gmail for messages newer than 2 days, calendar for today/tomorrow
how_to_steps: Open Claude Desktop app > Customize > Connectors; connect Gmail and Google Calendar
Go to Routines, paste the 'Daily inbox triage' prompt, click 'Draft routine'
Set trigger: Runs daily at 4:00 AM CDT (times are staggered to spread server load); confirm connectors Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Notion are available to the run
Click Create, then 'Run now' to test; open the run to see tool calls and the resulting Daily Briefing

Prompt structure (on screen): CONFIG block (name/sign-off, timezone, email accounts, voice, inbox window 'newer_than:2d', label IDs); one-time setup step 'use Gmail list labels tool to get real label IDs, fill CONFIG'; HARD RULE 'DRAFTS ONLY - never send'; steps: 1 CALENDAR list today's events, 2 INBOX search threads newer_than:2d and summarize by category (urgent/flagged/key contacts), 3 LABEL each thread with exactly one category, then compile a 5-10 minute readable briefing and a one-line summary
on_screen_only: Routine name 'Daily inbox triage' / 'Email and calendar assistant'
Prompt text: 'You are {{YOUR_NAME}}'s personal email + calendar assistant. Timezone {{TIMEZONE}}. Run this routine top to bottom... you are running in the cloud with no filesystem'

'=== CONFIG - fill in once ===' with {{ACCOUNTS}}, {{VOICE}}, inbox window newer_than:2d, Label IDs 'use your Gmail connector's list labels tool ONCE to get the real IDs (they look like Label_7, NOT the label names)'
'HARD RULE: DRAFTS ONLY - never send a reply'
'Runs are staggered by a few minutes to spread server load'
Warning: 'Claude can use all tools from these connectors - including write. Remove any you don't want the agent to access'
Daily Briefing - Monday, June 1, 2026 output with Slack UGC bot workflow error, LinkedIn security alert, brand quotes ($3k, $6k, $1,600)
Email from sahil.patel@okara.ai visible in inbox screenshot
cta: Comment 'inbox' to get the prompt free

relevance.why: Haji already has Gmail/Calendar connectors and routines; a drafts-only daily triage + briefing routine is directly reusable and the on-screen prompt skeleton (CONFIG block, label IDs, hard rules) is a concrete pattern

implement_score.why: ~30 min to adapt: write the CONFIG prompt, resolve Gmail label IDs once, keep DRAFTS ONLY rule, schedule at 4am. The haji-email skill already enforces an approval gate so the routine should stop at drafts + briefing

verify: Does Claude Desktop Routines expose Gmail 'list labels' and label-write tools in the cloud runner as shown?
Cost/quotas of daily routine runs on Haji's plan
Write access risk: the connector grants all tools including write; confirm the drafts-only rule is enforced by prompt only (no hard permission)

gap.what: Concrete prompt architecture for a scheduled Gmail triage routine: CONFIG header, one-time label-ID lookup, DRAFTS ONLY hard rule, 2-day inbox window, categorical labels, briefing format. Liked set covered chief-of-staff apps (Town, Jarvis) but not a copy-able Claude Routine prompt
